<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD is a conventional AUR binary repackaging script for OpenMac-for-Linux. It downloads the official GitHub release tarball and auxiliary metadata files (desktop entry, metainfo, icons) from the same upstream repository, and all sources carry sha256 checksums. The package() function copies the extracted payload into /usr/lib/openmac, drops the bundled SDL3 in favor of the system library, validates the presence of key .NET runtime files and managed assemblies, generates a launcher wrapper, and installs desktop/metainfo/icons/docs/license files. There are no network fetches beyond makepkg's standard source handling, no obfuscation, no eval or base64 usage, no data exfiltration, and no execution of downloaded code. The !strip option is justified because stripping a self-contained .NET bundle breaks it. This is ordinary AUR packaging practice with no evidence of supply-chain tampering.
</details>
